description: React component for a City Weather Check web application, including weather data fetching, auto-refresh, and a 'Can I Go Outside?' comfort score with tooltip explanations.

methods.name: estimateUVIndex
methods.description: Estimates UV index based on weather conditions for demo purposes.

methods.name: estimateAQI
methods.description: Estimates Air Quality Index based on weather data for demo purposes.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Fetches weather data for a city when Enter key is pressed.

methods.name: refreshWeather
methods.description: Refreshes weather data for the current city, used for auto-refresh.
